description:
If goods shall be shipped, the secretary clarifies who will do the shipping. 
If you have large amounts, special shipping will be necessary. 
In these cases the secretary invites three logistic companies to make offers and she selects one of them. 
In case of small amounts, normal post shipment is used. 
Therefore a package label is written by the secretary and a parcel insurance taken by the logistics department head if necessary. 
In the meantime the goods can be already packaged by the warehousemen. 
If everything is ready, the packaged goods are prepared for being picked up by the logistic company.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Shipping" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/shipping">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Shipping">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Shipping" name="Shipping Department" processRef="Process_Shipping"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LogisticCompanies" name="Logistic Companies"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Invitation" name="Invitation to make offers" sourceRef="Task_InviteCompanies" targetRef="Participant_LogisticCompanies"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offers" name="Offers" sourceRef="Participant_LogisticCompanies" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Shipping" name="Shipping of Goods" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Shipping">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Secretary" name="Secretary">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Shipment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ShipDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_NoShipment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelStart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ClarifyShipper</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AmountDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InviteCompanies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveOffers</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectOffer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NormalPost</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ShippingMethodMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WritePackageLabel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_LogisticsHead" name="Logistics Department Head">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InsuranceDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TakeInsurance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InsuranceMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Warehouse" name="Warehousemen">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PackageGoods</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareForPickup</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_ReadyForPickup</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Shipment" name="Goods to be shipped"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ShipDecision" name="Goods shall be shipped?" default="Flow_NoShipment"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NoShipment" name="No shipment needed"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelStart" name="Start shipment preparation"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ClarifyShipper" name="Clarify who will do the shipping"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AmountDecision" name="Large amount?" default="Flow_SmallAmount"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InviteCompanies" name="Invite three logistic companies to make offers"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffers" name="Receive offers"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectOffer" name="Select one offer"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NormalPost" name="Use normal post shipment"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ShippingMethodMerge" name="Shipping method determined"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InsuranceDecision" name="Parcel insurance necessary?" default="Flow_NoInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_TakeInsurance" name="Take parcel insurance"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InsuranceMerge" name="Insurance decision completed"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_WritePackageLabel" name="Write package label"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PackageGoods" name="Package goods"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Labelling and packaging complete"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PrepareForPickup" name="Prepare packaged goods for pickup by logistic company"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ReadyForPickup" name="Goods ready for pickup"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start" sourceRef="StartEvent_Shipment" targetRef="Gateway_ShipDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoShipment" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_NoShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shipment" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipDecision" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelStart">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${shipmentRequired}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToClarify" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelStart" targetRef="Task_ClarifyShipper"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToPackage" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelStart" targetRef="Task_PackageGoods"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ClarifyToAmount" sourceRef="Task_ClarifyShipper" targetRef="Gateway_AmountDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LargeAmount" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AmountDecision" targetRef="Task_InviteCompanies">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${largeAmount}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SmallAmount" name="No (small amount)" sourceRef="Gateway_AmountDecision" targetRef="Task_NormalPost"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InviteToReceive" sourceRef="Task_InviteCompanies" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveToSelect" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffers" targetRef="Task_SelectOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectToMerge" sourceRef="Task_SelectOffer" targetRef="Gateway_ShippingMethodMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostToMerge" sourceRef="Task_NormalPost" targetRef="Gateway_ShippingMethodMerge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToInsurance" sourceRef="Gateway_ShippingMethodMerge" targetRef="Gateway_InsuranceDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Insurance" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_InsuranceDecision" targetRef="Task_TakeInsurance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${insuranceNecessary}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoInsurance" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_InsuranceDecision" targetRef="Gateway_InsuranceMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsuranceToMerge" sourceRef="Task_TakeInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_InsuranceMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToLabel" sourceRef="Gateway_InsuranceMerge" targetRef="Task_WritePackageLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LabelToJoin" sourceRef="Task_WritePackageLabel" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PackageToJoin" sourceRef="Task_PackageGoods" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToPickup" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_PrepareForPickup"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PickupToEnd" sourceRef="Task_PrepareForPickup" targetRef="EndEvent_ReadyForPickup"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
